originalTitle: How Much Could You Lose In NuScale Power Stock?
summary: NuScale Power (SMR) stock has lost 31% in the past month, while the S&P 500 gained 1.8%. content:
NuScale Power (SMR) stock has lost 31% in the past month, while the S&P 500 gained 1.8%. The decline happened without any specific news from the company, though peer Oklo lost 15.0% over the same month. Investors are waiting for NuScale to sign a commercial contract for its reactors, and the company continues to spend cash while they wait. So how far has NuScale stock fallen in past market sell-offs?

NuScale Stock Dropped 72% When Bond Yields Hit 5%

That decline occurred between July and December 2023, a period when the S&P 500 fell 9.5%. It ranks as the deepest fall NuScale has taken in a market shock . The stock has only traded publicly since 2020, yet it has already been through five such shocks.

Across those five periods, NuScale fell 40.2% on average, compared with 13.4% for the S&P 500. That represents roughly three times the market’s loss. The company lost 40% in the 2025 tariff shock, landing right near that historical average. Over a longer stretch, the damage has been even steeper. From its 2022 peak to its 2024 low, the stock lost 87%.

Recovery times have varied. NuScale ultimately returned to its pre-shock high after all five falls, with a median wait from the low of 4.2 months. The longest wait came after the 2022 inflation shock, stretching to 21.0 months.

Can NuScale Afford To Wait For A Contract?

For now, the answer is yes. NuScale held about $1.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents and investments at the end of June, management said on the August 5, 2026 call. Operations used $0.8 billion of cash over the last twelve months, meaning the $1.9 billion stockpile would cover more than two years at the same pace. The company also carries almost no debt, whereas debt equals 21.4% of market value for the S&P 500.

The business itself brings in very little money. Revenue was just $0.1 million in the quarter ended June 30, 2026, against $8.1 million a year earlier. Management said the drop followed the completion in late 2025 of engineering design work for the RoPower project. Over the last twelve months, the operating loss reached $0.7 billion for a company the market values at $2.8 billion. Furthermore, the share count has risen 405.4% in three years.

Is NuScale Any Closer To A Signed Contract?

Not on paper, at least as of the August 5 call. Management described the commercial contract as the main catalyst for the company. NuScale partner ENTRA1 is currently in talks with the Tennessee Valley Authority toward a definitive power purchase agreement. Management said its understanding was that those talks were active and progressing. When asked what still stood in the way, management said only that it was encouraged by the conversations.

The other contract NuScale is waiting on is in Romania. Management said the RoPower project there will deploy six NuScale power modules at a former coal plant site. A new government was being seated in the country at the time of the call, and management said it was waiting for the green light to finalize its contract agreements.

Management also declined on that call to provide guidance on its operating costs for the coming quarters.

chineseTitle: NuScale Power 股票可能会损失多少？
chineseSummary: NuScale Power (SMR) 股票在过去一个月下跌了 31%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨了 1.8%。尽管同行 Oklo 同月下跌 15.0%，但该公司没有任何具体消息，但股价却出现了下跌。投资者正在等待 NuScale 为其反应堆签署​​商业合同，而该公司在等待期间继续支出现金。那么 NuScale 股票在过去的市场抛售中下跌了多少？
chineseContent:
NuScale Power (SMR) 股票在过去一个月下跌了 31%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨了 1.8%。尽管同行 Oklo 同月下跌 15.0%，但该公司没有任何具体消息，但股价却出现了下跌。投资者正在等待 NuScale 为其反应堆签署​​商业合同，而该公司在等待期间继续支出现金。那么，NuScale 股票在过去的市场抛售中下跌了多少呢？

当债券收益率触及 5% 时，NuScale 股价下跌 72%

这一下跌发生在 2023 年 7 月至 12 月期间，标准普尔 500 指数在此期间下跌了 9.5%。这是 NuScale 在市场冲击中遭遇的最严重跌幅。该股自 2020 年以来才公开交易，但已经经历了五次这样的冲击。

在这五个时期，NuScale 平均下跌 40.2%，而标准普尔 500 指数平均下跌 13.4%。这大约是市场损失的三倍。该公司在 2025 年关税冲击中损失了 40%，接近历史平均水平。随着时间的推移，损害会更加严重。从 2022 年的峰值到 2024 年的低点，该股下跌了 87%。

恢复时间各不相同。 NuScale 在五次下跌后最终回到了冲击前的高点，中位等待时间为 4.2 个月的低点。最长的等待发生在 2022 年通胀冲击之后，长达 21.0 个月。

NuScale 可以等待合同吗？

目前来看，答案是肯定的。管理层在 2026 年 8 月 5 日的电话会议上表示，截至 6 月底，NuScale 持有约 19 亿美元的现金、现金等价物和投资。过去 12 个月，运营使用了 8 亿美元的现金，这意味着 19 亿美元的库存按同样的速度可以维持两年多的时间。该公司几乎没有债务，而债务相当于标准普尔 500 指数市值的 21.4%。

该业务本身带来的收入很少。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度收入仅为 10 万美元，而上年同期收入为 810 万美元。管理层表示，RoPower 项目的工程设计工作于 2025 年底完成，导致这一下降。过去 12 个月，这家市值 28 亿美元的公司的营业亏损达到 7 亿美元。此外，三年内股票数量增加了405.4%。

NuScale 是否更接近签署合同？

至少在 8 月 5 日的电话会议上是这样的。管理层将商业合同描述为公司的主要催化剂。 NuScale 合作伙伴 ENTRA1 目前正在与田纳西河谷管理局就最终购电协议进行谈判。管理层表示，据了解，这些谈判正在积极进行并取得进展。当被问及仍然存在哪些障碍时，管理层仅表示，这些对话让他们感到鼓舞。

NuScale 正在等待的另一份合同位于罗马尼亚。管理层表示，RoPower 项目将在前燃煤电厂所在地部署六个 NuScale 电源模块。电话会议召开时，该国正在组建新政府，管理层表示正在等待最终敲定合同协议的批准。

管理层还拒绝就未来几个季度的运营成本提供指导。

这是否意味着您应该采取 SMR 行动？

我们的目的是为您提供独特的数据，以便您做出正确的投资决策。也就是说，无论您选择哪个方向，押注单一股票总是有风险的。

有一个更聪明的方法。自成立以来，Trefis High Quality (HQ) 投资组合的回报率为 105%，超过了结合三大指数（S&P 500、S&P Mid-cap 和 Russell 2000）的基准。而且它没有承担自行选股带来的集中风险。如果这就是您想要的投资方式，那么总部投资组合就是您的起点。
